name: animal-imagemasking
title: Animal Shape Image Mask
description: Renders a grid of images clipped to animal shapes (cat, panda) using CSS mask-image. Requires pre-existing SVG masks in public/.
use_when: Playful galleries, pet-themed sections, or creative image layouts.
avoid_when: Browsers lacking mask-image support (IE, older Safari); images without good SVG masks.
a11y: Static grid; no interaction. SVG masks require alt text on images.
